subject: [PATCH 10/10] mm/madvise: share cold and pageout walk setup

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch refactors the shared TLB and page-walk setup for MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT operations in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise module. It introduces a new helper function, madvise_lru_vma_range(), which is used by both entry points to perform the common setup tasks. The patch aims to reduce code duplication and improve maintainability without introducing any functional changes.
